name: Then and now
summary: Freshman year and senior year of the same friends as two drawn panels with a wipe handle: drag it and each friend changes from then to now with their own then-and-now lines, or play it as a short reel that lands on a beat.
useWhen: make a then and now reel of the six
look how much we changed since orientation
dontUseWhen: a full recap of the year's chats (use wrapped)
a memory you want to plan again (use memory-redo)

thenPlace.description: Where the old photo was, e.g. 'Hollis Dining Hall · orientation'

nowPlace.description: Where the new photo was, e.g. 'the Quad · last week'

then.description: Who they were then, a few words in the group's voice

now.description: Who they are now, a few words

watched.description: Who already watched it to the end
